description.value: Skewers Souvlaki Pita Bar is an authentic Greek restaurant in Vancouver's historic Gastown neighborhood, serving souvlaki wraps, platters, and fresh salads made with BC-farmed chicken and pork and New Zealand lamb sirloin marinated in-house for twelve hours. Located on Powell Street near the waterfront, it is a convenient and filling stop for cyclists passing through the city core. Online ordering and pickup are available for those who want to grab a hearty meal on the go.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 8m; stands (4 spaces) at 44m; stands (2 spaces) at 74m; stands at 85m; stands at 98m. Total: 8 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active Greek restaurant at 26 Powell St, Gastown, with phone (604) 566-5257 and online ordering matching OSM data. Takeout is explicitly confirmed via 'call us to order pickup' and prominent ORDER ONLINE CTAs throughout the site; vegetarian options (Halloumi Cheese wrap, Greek and Cretan salads) are confirmed on the menu page. No evidence of bike parking, bike racks, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any cycling-specific amenity was found anywhere in the website content.
concerns: Two different email addresses appear on the website: 'info@skewersgastown.ca' in the header/footer of most pages, and 'info@skewerspitabar.com' in the body of the contact page — possible outdated content or brand transition.

Opening hours are inconsistent across website pages: the contact page body shows later closing times (Mon–Thu 10 pm, Fri–Sat 11 pm, Sun 10 pm) than the header and other pages (Mon/Sun/Wed/Thu 9:30 pm, Fri–Sat 10:30 pm, Tue 9:30 pm), and both differ from OSM hours. Hours data should be independently verified before publishing.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, established Greek restaurant in Gastown offering takeout and online ordering — a practical and filling food stop for touring cyclists moving through central Vancouver.
enrichment_extras.notes: Catering is listed as a service on the website navigation, though no cyclist-relevant details (e.g. group meals, packed lunches) are described.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes vegetarian options: Halloumi Cheese wrap, Mixed Salad with Feta, Greek Salad, and Cretan Salad. No explicit vegan or gluten-free claims found

wow_evidence: authentic Greek restaurant in Vancouver's historic Gastown neighborhood

price.label: Casual
price.signal: Wraps $15–17.50, platters $19–22, emphasizes fair prices and generous portions
